name: silon
description: Install self-hosted Silon and search the Silon API reference and SDK guides.

interface.shortDescription: Install Silon and use its API
interface.longDescription: Plan or install Silon on Google Cloud, AWS, Azure, or an existing Linux server. When the session can operate an authenticated terminal or a browser with Cloud Shell, the skill can run the Silon CLI after the user approves billable resources. Other sessions can prepare Cloud Shell or SSH commands. The bundled public documentation connector searches the Silon API reference and finds SDK examples. It only reads public documentation and requires no Silon account or API key.
defaultPrompt: Plan a Silon trial on Google Cloud without creating resources yet.
Walk me through installing Silon on my existing Linux server.
Find the Silon API documentation and a Python example for sending a message.

positive.prompt: Use the Silon docs connector to tell me what documentation it can look up.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the connector's public documentation scope.

positive.prompt: Search the Silon API docs for the createMessage operation. Open the matching result and cite its source.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the API operation and cite the public reference.

positive.prompt: List the SDKs and code example languages available through the Silon docs connector.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the SDKs and languages returned by the tool.

positive.prompt: Look up the Silon SDK's Python example for the createMessage operation and explain its inputs.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the documented Python example using placeholders for secrets.

positive.prompt: Find and open the Silon API documentation for webhook endpoints and summarize what they do.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize webhook endpoints using a public source from the connector.

negative.prompt: Use the Silon docs connector to send an SMS to my customer.
Use the Silon docs connector to list the contacts in my private Silon workspace.
Use the Silon docs connector to buy a licence and charge my saved card.

publication.release_notes: Explains how to finish deployment in the user's own browser when the agent's Cloud Shell access is blocked.
